heading: Weekly online mindfulness & wellbeing community
lead: A calm online space for mindfulness, stress reduction, and community connection.
imageAlt: A woman sitting quietly on a wooden dock beside still water at dusk.
intro: The Weekly Wellbeing Community is your weekly invitation to self-care — a calm, protected space to arrive back with yourself and strengthen your emotional wellbeing for the long term.

In our weekly 60-minute meetings, we spend around 30 to 45 minutes on guided mindfulness practices and nervous system regulation. Afterwards, there is room for a compassionate, judgment-free exchange.
No pressure to perform and no obligation to share: here you are welcome exactly as you are. The aim is a deeper, more authentic sense of connection — with yourself and with a supportive community.

quotes.text: The weekly hour of wellbeing is sacred to me. Each time, I take away something important and good — and the world becomes a little kinder, and life a little more beautiful.
Theresa's compassionate approach and profound understanding of the human mind have been truly enriching.

closing.heading: You are welcome to join
closing.body: If you'd like to receive more information about the Weekly Wellbeing Community, you are warmly welcome to get in touch.
